description: Create a new server-owned sandbox session (headless, in-process). With no arguments it is an empty workbook; `path` opens a workbook from disk; `source` clones another session (its workbook is snapshotted into a fresh sandbox you can edit in isolation). Returns the new session_id to pass to run/grep/etc.

origin.description: How the sandbox is seeded. Inferred from `path` / `source` when omitted; pass it only to be explicit, and it must agree with them.

path.description: Open a workbook from disk: absolute or workspace-relative path.

name: session_create
